name: full_came_task_grid_resumable
notes: All ten CAME downstream domains, separate few-shot corpus, ten downstream seeds, Wiki-CS node Cartesian grid 20 splits x 20 initializations, CLIP baselines and all nine Table 3 ablations are queued without per-job time or epoch truncation.

One pretrained encoder is reused across downstream seeds. The author does not specify enough to establish whether pretraining itself was independently repeated; this is not ten independent pretraining runs.
Fixed seed-pool sizes, Books/Cloth caps, PPR parameters, optimizer and gradient clipping remain disclosed reconstruction choices.
24 hours is a CUMULATIVE active runtime cap across restarts; paused downtime is excluded and unfinished jobs remain pending.
Other baseline methods and paper noise/sensitivity/t-SNE/expert/efficiency analyses are coverage gaps, not reported as completed by this grid.
